notes.title: Valve Index Compatibility Patch
notes.notes:
Greetings Wizards,

today we're rolling out a new patch that addresses reported issues with the Valve Index, along with some minor fixes.

Patchnotes:
[list]
[*]Fixed issues with movement and rotation on Valve Index
[*]Fixed bug with Fireball Master Upgrade
[/list]

No further action should be necessary, however [b]if you still experience movement issues while playing on Valve Index, try re-calibrating the controller thumbsticks in SteamVR settings.[/b]

[i]Happy spellcasting![/i]

notes.title: Index Patch for The Wizards - Enhanced Edition is live!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

We just released a patch for The Wizards - Enhanced Edition that fixes the reported issues with Index Controllers, along with some quality of life changes.

[b]Key changes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Index: improved the position of hands in virtual reality
[*]Index: adjusted the sensitivity of rotation using thumbstick
[*]Left-handed mode: it is now possible to summon the fireball with left hand while holding the shield with right hand
[*]Added prompts informing the player about reaching checkpoints
[/list]

I encourage everyone who experienced gameplay issues with Index Controllers to download the update and give the game a spin again.

Join us on [url=https://discord.gg/becomeawizard]Discord[/url]! Your feedback gets to us faster that way.

notes.title: 1st Anniversary Update!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/sLyFA4q.gif[/img]

[h1]Dear Wizards,[/h1]

It’s unbelievable how fast time flies by! It feels like our game was released in Early Access only yesterday, and now it’s time to celebrate its first anniversary! This was a year of hard but fruitful work for Carbon Studio. The progress we’ve made since the early release would not be possible without the feedback from the community. Big shout-out to everyone who supported us, from alpha and beta testings, through Early Access, up to the full release, and beyond!

Since July 2017, The Wizards has changed significantly. We have rebuilt the locomotion system from node-based teleportation to free movement + free teleportation, more than doubled the amount of available levels, added boss fights, Arena Mode, more cutscenes, enemies and spells, and support for left-handed players. If you haven’t tried the game after the full release, now is the best time to revisit the realm of Meliora! This little fella can’t wait to meet you:

[img]https://i.imgur.com/jUztP3B.gif[/img]

Naturally, we aren’t arriving at the first anniversary party empty-handed. In the second update after the full release, we introduce major user interface overhaul and redesigned final combat on the first level of the game (see the screenshot below). It may be a treat even for those who have finished the game already. Why don’t you revisit this level with some rule-changing Fate Cards?

[h1]Update 1.02 Changelog:[/h1]

[b]GENERAL[/b]
[list]
[*]User interface redesign - menus within the game received an overhaul
[*]Minor localization tweaks
[*]Minor collision tweaks on all levels
[*]Minor enemy navigation correction
[/list]
[b]LEVELS[/b]
[list]

[*]Ruins
- Redesigned last fight on the first Stage (Arena with a Crystal)
- Belltower sequence visual guidance improved
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/0fH9PLT.jpg[/img]

We believe that year two will be an equally exciting time for The Wizards. Thank you for joining us on this adventure!  Ah, and please remember to join our wizards community on  [url=https://discord.gg/becomeawizard]Discord![/url]

Cheers,

[b]Carbon Studio Team[/b]

notes.title: Full Release is here!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/PCKjk1T.gif[/img]

[h1]Brave Wizards![/h1]

We are excited to announce that the full release has successfully left Early Access with new stages, epic bosses and empowered spells for the ultimate wizardry!

We want to express our gratitude to everyone who trusted and supported us with feedback during Early Access. We are humbled that so many of you joined us on this exciting adventure. 

The journey is not over though. In the upcoming months we will focus on preparing Playstation VR version of The Wizards, and during this process we will update Steam version of The Wizards with fixes, improvements and some new content.

We hope that you will enjoy exploring the richness of the full release update. You're invited to join our wizards community on  [url=https://discord.gg/becomeawizard]Discord![/url]


[h1]HIGHLIGHTS OF THIS UPDATE:[/h1]

[h1]Completed story with new stages (Ruins 2, Ruins 3 and Desert 3)[/h1]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/B0xbXZh.gif[/img]


[h1]Master Enchantments for all the spells (Yep. You can throw a shield now!)[/h1]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/MCVS6Ee.gif[/img]


[h1]Dynamic lighting from all the spells and improved performance[/h1]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/StJ06Dz.gif[/img]


[h1]New cutscenes[/h1]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/wtu9U3H.gif[/img]


[h1]Full Changelog:[/h1]

Disclaimer: Due to changes in progression, all spell upgrades got reset and Spell Potential achieved on Ruins Stages 1-4 got taken away. Sorry for the inconvenience!

[b]GENERAL CHANGES[/b]
[list]
[*]Added two big bosses to hurl fireballs at
[*]Major optimization of an entire game
[*]All the spells are now casting dynamic lighting
[*]Added new Fate Card - Easy Prey
[*]Introduced Steam Achievements - Go get’em all!
[*]Added missing translations and subtitles
[*]Glass bottles are now breakable!


[*]Campaign
- Added some changes to lore and dialogues
- Added cutscenes introducing missing story parts
- Added stage summary while holding the stage glyph
- Added fourth gem slot to the stage figures representing collected fairy shards
- Tweaked points requirement for most stages
- Telekinetic doors have been entirely removed
- All Ruins levels have to be completed before unlocking next chapter

[*]Ruins
- Waveshooter stages has been moved from Campaign to Arena Mode
- Added two brand new stages - Catacombs and Revenant’s Lair
- Introduction of new gameplay mechanics and a new Fate Card
- Pinewood intro cutscene has been updated
- Stage 1 last combat around crystal is now a bit easier

[*]Desert
- Added region finale - 3rd stage with a boss fight
- Ethereal crystals are now easier to remove from hands

[*]Dungeon
- Gameplay changes due to removal of telekinetic doors


[/list]

[b]SPELLS[/b]
[list]
[*]Master Upgrades available for all six spells
[*]After obtaining both basic upgrades Master challenge is unlocked - upon completion you will be rewarded with a Master Upgrade
[*]Spells are now much more responsive and easy to cast
[*]Improvements of spells visuals
[*]Added vibration feedback while holding Fireball or Pyroblast
[/list]
[b]Frost Bow:[/b]
[list]
[*]Master Challenge: Kill 2 enemies with a single arrow
[*]Master Upgrade: Ice Volley - Shooting an arrow in the sky will cause a volley of arrows to fall wherever the previous shot from the bow landed
[/list]
[b]Fireball:[/b]
[list]
[*]Master Challenge: Hit an enemy with two empowered fireballs within 1 second
[*]Master Upgrade: Hellfire - Hitting an ignited enemy sets nearby monsters on fire
[/list]
[b]Arcane Shield:[/b]
[list]
[*]Master Challenge: Kill an enemy within 1 second after blocking his attack with the shield
[*]Master Upgrade:  Aegis Throw - The shield can be thrown at enemies to deal damage
[/list]
[b]Lighting:[/b]
[list]
[*]Master Challenge: Kill two different types of enemies with a single cast of Lightning
[*]Master Upgrade: Double Discharge - After casting the spell, both hands can be aimed individually
[/list]
[b]Arcane Missiles:[/b]
[list]
[*]Master Challenge: Master Challenge: Cast perfect fully empowered Arcane Missiles
[*]Master Upgrade: Arcane Barrage - The projectiles duplicate in the air.
[/list]
[b]Pyroblast:[/b]
[list]
[*]Master Challenge: Kill 3 enemies with a single Pyroblast
[*]Master Upgrade: Inferno - Pyroblast spits sparks around when flying by, dealing damage to nearby enemies
[/list]

[b]MAJOR BUG FIXES[/b]
[list]
[*]Fate Cards should no longer disappear after restarting game
[*]Destructible walls are no longer attacking players
[*]Tutorial widgets won’t disturb aiming anymore
[*]Fixed progression blocker caused by backtracking on Dungeon
[*]Enemies electrocuted by Lightning’ are now properly animated
[*]Walls destroyed by cannons are now disappearing fluently
[*]Burning a pickup object while still holding in hand will not make the hand disappear
[/list]


Bonus: The Wizards supports mixed reality gameplay capture powered by http://LIV.tv
Have a look how awesome it looks!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/DhMHWC9.gif[/img]


[h1]You're welcome to join our [url=https://discord.gg/becomeawizard]Discord server[/url] and share your feedback![/h1]

notes.title: Release date announced
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/xWWPVwK.gif[/img]

[h1]Brave Wizards![/h1]

We are excited to share with you that we are getting ready to release a full version of our game - and now we can say it officially:

[h1]The Wizards will leave Early Access on March 8th, 2018! [/h1]

Upon full release, The Wizards will welcome you with lots of new content, improvements and bug fixes. Here are the most important changes and new features:
[list]
    [*] Two new stages on the Ruins
    [*] Final stage on the Shrike's Desert that will conclude the story
    [*] Boss fights with fearsome creatures
    [*] Wave-based Ruins stages will be moved to the Arena Mode
    [*] Master Enchantments - powerful upgrades for all the spells
    [*] Steam Achievements
[/list]
We are very grateful for all the support we've got from you during the past seven months. We are humbled that so many of you decided to trust us an buy the game in its early stage. Now when the game is almost finished, we are convinced that it's your valuable feedback and patience that brought us so far. Thank you!

That's not everything we've prepared for you. Starting today, The Wizards officially supports LIV Mixed Reality technology! If you produce VR videos or streams, you can now use LIV client to capture MR in our game. And if you don't, please enjoy the following trailer we've prepared with LIV, and expect more goodies coming soon!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=agXsdLRAUrI
Head here for more details about LIV: https://liv.tv/
You can also wishlist LIV client on Steam!


We would like to assure you that the full release will not be the end of our work on The Wizards. We will keep working on new features and improvements based on your feedback. Details on the new content coming after leaving Early Access will be revealed soon.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28162785/92498b5ec600499b8e2a4e47a4d2704d6497b392.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Patch 1.2.2 Left-handed mode, VRWorks + more!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/xbVdvXg.gif[/img]

[h1]Brave Wizards![/h1]

It's finally here! Left-handed mode, feature highly anticipated by ~12% of you, is now available in the game. We hoped to add this feature earlier, but it was much more difficult to implement than it may seem. Also, from this update owners of NVIDIA cards can take advantage of NVIDIA VRWorks™ that increase performance and allow for a new level of visual fidelity. 

Right-handed players and owners of AMD cards - No worries, we still have you covered!

Last but not least, we’re happy to announce that The Wizards is now available on [url=https://store.smartvr-studio.com/]smartVR Store[/url] all-in-one solution for VR arcades. 



[h1]What's next?[/h1]

We are getting closer to the full release of The Wizards. We've introduced most of the features and content promised for the Early Access. If everything goes well, full release will happen this March. Here are some of the things we are working on right now:
[list][*]Moving wave-based stages (Ruins) from Campaign to Arena Mode
[*]New exploration-based stages on Ruins to replace the wave-based ones
[*]Final stage for Shrike's Desert region that will conclude the campaign
[*]Steam Achievements [/list]
Please let us know how do you like the progress of The Wizards so far and what features do you think we should definitely add before leaving Early Access! You're invited to join our [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/becomeawizard]Discord server[/url] and share your feedback. You're also welcome to share your thoughts in a review.



[h1][b]Update 1.2.2 Changelog:[/b][/h1]

[h1][b]Left-handed Mode[/b][/h1]
[list][*]Can be turned on while starting new campaign and in game's settings
[*]Affects dominant hand for summoning spells and interactions
[*]Does not flip movement/teleportation on the controllers. This can be changed separately.
[/list]
[h1][b]Spells[/b][/h1]
[list][*][b]Frost bow [/b]- Inverted upgrade order
[*][b]Pyroblast [/b]- Scorched Earth upgrade now deals more damage over time
[*]Added ring borders around spell selectors to indicate the level of the spell
[/list]
[h1][b]Other changes[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Implemented NVIDIA VRWorks™ technology
[*]Tutorial in the campaign can now be skipped
[*]Major graphical optimization of Shrike's Desert
[*]Books, scrolls and sketches are now flammable[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/awwQcDT.gif[/img]

notes.title: Update 1.2.1 Shrike Desert
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/xWWPVwK.gif[/img]

[h1]Brave Wizards![/h1]

We’re excited to let you experience brand new chapter of the game as an open beta - meet [b]Shrike’s Desert![/b] It’s a third story chapter of the game and one of our main promises for the Early Access. We’ve finished two stages of this chapter and decided to invite you to test it and share your feedback before we put the final touches to this section of the game.


https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=icFy9BUTIpY

[h1][b]Update 1.2.1 Changelog:[/b][/h1]

[h1][b]Shrike’s Desert[/b] - New Region:[/h1]
[list][*]The Shrike Desert is located in eastern Meliora. It is a lifeless landscape ravaged by dense, magic-fueled sandstorms. At the central point of the region lie the ruins of Shrike’s Lookout, an ancient sandstone fortress that has been torn apart by a violent magical explosion many centuries ago. The aftershocks of that explosion still resonate among the ruins, and allow ethereal phenomena to pass through the veil between worlds and haunt the area. Indeed a perfect spot to look for a villain…[/list]

[h1][b]Ethereal Phantoms[/b] - New Enemy:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Odd apparitions that roam the desert and come after any newcomer
[*]Deal damage and are destroyed upon impact
[*]Invulnerable to regular spells - can only be defeated with Ethereal Spears[/list]

[h1][b]Desert Serpents[/b] - New Enemy:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Enormous, semi-sentient guardians brought to life by an ancient spell that spring up from beneath the sand to hurl fire-based spells at trespassers
[*]Can spawn anywhere on a mostly flat, sandy surface
[*]Two attacks: a fiery orb similar to Pyroblast and a fiery barrage that rains from above[/list]

[h1][b]Ethereal Spear[/b] - New Spell:[/h1]
[list]
[*]New type of Ethereal Magic used to get rid of ethereal phantoms and barriers
[*]Place your hand in the ethereal lantern to infuse yourself with the ethereal power which allows to summon Ethereal Spears[/list]

[h1][b]New Fate Cards:[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Two new cards hidden in the desert regions:
[*][b]Fortify:[/b] The player has more Time Synchronization points (multiplier: -0.25)
[*][b]Fragile:[/b] The player has less Time Synchronization points (multiplier: +0.25)[/list]

[h1][b]Fixes and improvements:[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Polished hit animations 
[*]Improved throwing with Fireball and Pyroblast while walking
[*]Minor optimization fixes for Mountainpass Castle arena
[*]Shamans’ projectiles are now homing slightly towards the player[/list]

[h1][b]Support for KAT WALK VR Treadmill:[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]From this update, The Wizards natively supports KAT VR treadmill. Ask your local VR arcade about it, it's a blast!
[*]Game can also be played with WASD on experimental locomotion peripherals[/list]

[h1]What's next?[/h1]
In the following weeks, we’ll be working on a third, final stage of Shrike’s Desert. It will be released along with some new content in the previous stages, thus expanding and fleshing out the story of you and Aurelius.

Many thanks for all the amazing support and brilliant suggestions we received from you! We invite you to visit our [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/becomeawizard]Discord server[/url] and share your feedback. We also encourage you to write reviews to share your experience with fellow players on Steam.

notes.title: Update 1.2: Arena Mode!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/MM3TPiA.jpg[/img]

[h1]Brave Wizards![/h1]

It's been quite an adventure for our team since the Early Access release roughly three months ago. We have slightly altered our initial plan of updates to introduce free locomotion that was requested by many of you. 

Today, we're proud to roll out the first major update with new content we've promised to add during Early Access. We invite you to assail with endless hordes of enemies on two brand new battle arenas!

Arena Mode (formerly Arcade Mode) introduces two arenas, new hub, unique Fate Cards and progress system independent of the campaign. Each arena has it's own objective:

[h1][b]Mountainpass Castle[/b] (Point Defense)[/h1]
You have to defend 3 crystals spread across the map with paths changing with each wave.
[img]http://i.imgur.com/olU4pkr.gif[/img]


[h1][b]Crystal Caverns[/b] (Seek & Destroy)[/h1]
Look for corrupted crystals and destroy them before there is too many. 
[img]http://i.imgur.com/6vjRrp1.gif[/img]



[h1]What's next?[/h1]
Our plan is to keep delivering content promised for the Early Access along with bug fixes and improvements suggested by you, dear players. In around four weeks we plan to roll out next major update introducing third Region (story chapter) to the game.

We want to thank you for all the feedback and amazing support we receive! We invite you to visit our [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/becomeawizard]Discord server[/url] and join the discussion. We also encourage you to write reviews to share your experience with fellow players on Steam.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9n9ml0jPsiY

[h1]Update 1.2 Changelog:[/h1]

[b]MAJOR CHANGES[/b]
[list]
[*]Brand new Arena Mode with two battle arenas
[*]Improved throwing with the fireball
[*]Improved optimization throughout the game
[*]Visual tweaks for spells and levels
[*]You can no longer get hit by the falling bell

[*]Movement
- Teleportation range shortens with each teleportation (only in combat)
- Teleportation indicator changes color when player is in combat
- Minor fixes on levels and in navigation

[*]World interactions
- Fireball and Pyroblast are now extinguished upon touching water
- Books and scrolls are now flammable
- Fairy shards already found earlier now spawn facing the player
[/list]

[b]SPELLS[/b]
[list]
[*]Added the ability to adjust aim assist in general options
[*]Added controller rumble to drawing Frost Bow and releasing an arrow
[*]Improved explosion visuals of various spells
[/list]
[b]Fireball:[/b]
[list]
[*]Improved throwing while moving
[*]Improved throwing overall
[*]Improved explosion visuals
[*]Fixed timing on charging effects
[/list]

[b]ENEMIES[/b]
[list]
[*]Added [b]Troll Shaman[/b] - new ranged enemy who summons explosive traps under your feet
[*]Added new variation of the basic enemy with plate armor and additional HP
[*]Spellcatcher now has a tooltip that shows up when player has trouble fighting it
[*]Minor AI fixes.
[/list]

[b]KNOWN ISSUES[/b]
[list]
[*] Arena Mode can still be a little bit unbalanced. We're looking forward to your feedback and ideas for improvements.
[*]“Level of Details” of objects need changes. Currently textures change quality at player’s eyes.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.1: Free locomotion and more!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Gxf94yj.jpg[/img]

[h1]Brave Wizards![/h1]

After six weeks of hard work, free locomotion update is finally ready! This is what you, dear players, asked for and... you know what? You were totally right! We can’t wait for the feedback after you try the game with free movement and free teleportation. But that’s not all. We’re also introducing plenty of new features to enhance the experience of free exploration.


[b][h1]HIGHLIGHTS:[/h1][/b]

[h1]Fully customizable free movement...[/h1]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/gpOe5wQ.gif[/img]

[h1]… and free teleportation[/h1]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/3auMaig.gif[/img]

[h1]New area on Ruins Stage 1 - make sure to revisit it![/h1]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Fsp1oOI.jpg[/img]

[h1]Item pick-ups[/h1]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/UR37Wfl.gif[/img]

[h1]Interactive crank wheels (grab and rotate)[/h1]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/879yXVC.jpg[/img]

[h1]Blocking melee attacks with shield[/h1]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/4cOpbX9.gif[/img]

[h1]New tutorial[/h1]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/0xMDmAZ.jpg[/img]

[h1]Hourglasses (restore HP / give more points)[/h1]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/MlI2alV.gif[/img]

[h1]Fireball and Frost Bow visuals enhanced[/h1]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/QY0FXaI.gif[/img]


We’ve been waiting for this moment for the long time and we hope that you’ll like the new movement schemes and new possibilities as much as we do. Please be forgiving if you encounter any bugs. Redesigning the whole game for free locomotion might generate more bugs than we could detect.

When you run the game for the first time after the update, you’ll have to finish a new tutorial, even if you’ve already played The Wizards. We’d also like to encourage everyone who have played the game before to revisit Stage One on Ruins. Now, it’s longer, with new encounters, puzzles and precious items to collect.


[h1]What's coming next?[/h1]
In the following weeks, we’re going to release some small patches that would fix bugs and be a response to your suggestions. Next major update will introduce Arcade Mode with two new stages and a new spell. We’re open to your ideas so please join our [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/becomeawizard]Discord server[/url] and Discussion on Community Hub.



[h1]Update 1.1 Changelog:[/h1]

[b]GENERAL CHANGES[/b]
[list]
[*]Added free locomotion
- Added free movement
- Added free teleportation
- Changes in node-based teleportation
- Customization options for movement

[*]Rework of tutorial area
- Pocket dimension is now bigger and more interesting visually
- Added tutorials for free movement, teleportation and shield
- Objectives help to guide the player
- More 2D graphics explaining keybindings and required actions
- Added silhouettes helping to cast spells
- Changes in tutorial glyphs

[*]Rework of Ruins Stage 1
- Added new area - castle
- Added new encounter
- Changes in first encounter
- Removed metal gates from the crystal battle
- Changed the timing of enemies during the crystal battle
- Added environmental puzzle

[*]Added immersive mode - you can now hide the interface 
[*]Dungeon Region is now fully explorable
[*]Fate Cards now need to be found in chests
[*]Added Hourglasses (restore HP / rewards with points if HP is full)
[*]Added Crystal Shards rewarding player with Spell Potential
[*]Added grab-and-rotate mechanic for crank handles
[*]Fate cards are from now unlocked right after finishing tutorial
[*]Minecart now stops when colliding with player
[*]Leaderboards are now always visible in HUB
[*]Interface (health and tutorials) is now following camera faster
[*]Teleporter traps have been completely removed from game
[*]Banners can now be burned
[*]Player's hands reflect now more light
[*][i]Experimental - WASD support for VR treadmills[/i]
[/list]

[b]SPELLS[/b]
[list]
[*]Minor auto-aim fixes to projectile spells
[*]Idle Arcane Missiles are now more lively
[/list]
[b]Frost Bow:[/b]
[list]
[*]Changed the bow and arrow visuals.
[*]Added trail to the arrow
[/list]
[b]Fireball:[/b]
[list]
[*]Complete visual rework. Fireball is now more fire than ball.
[*]Added fiery trail behind fireball
[*]Fixed the lack of auto-aim when thrown with the left hand
[/list]
[b]Arcane Shield:[/b]
[list]
[*]Shield is now unlocked from the beginning
[*]Added the ability to block melee attacks
[*]Moved the shield closer to the player
[/list]

[b]ENEMIES[/b]
[list]
[*]Minor AI tweaks
[*]All enemies have now knockback effect when blocked with a shield
[*]Enemy projectiles are now faster
[*]Fixed the bug making Spell Catcher ignore fireballs thrown with left hand
[/list]

[b]AUDIO[/b]
[list]
[*]Minor changes in arcane missiles SFX
[*]Added sounds for blocking with shield
[*]Improved enemy footsteps
[*]Added player’s footsteps
[*]Improved audio of orange glyphs on levels. 
[*]Minor fixes in Chinese dubbing
[*]New voices and sounds for Pocket Dimension and for Ruins Stage 1
[*]Ice Bow’s SFXes are now a bit louder
[*]New SFX for channelling
[/list]

[b]KNOWN ISSUES[/b]
[list]
[*]“Level of Details” of objects need changes. Currently textures change quality at player’s eyes.
[/list]

[h1]You're welcome to join our [url=https://discord.gg/xctRHJn]Discord server[/url] and share your feedback![/h1]

notes.title: Patch 1.02 is Live!
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/Lnow3mZ.gif[/img]

[h1]Brave Wizards![/h1]

Thank you for your amazing support and constructive feedback.  We've just released a patch that fixes reported bugs and improves casting spells. 

We'd also like to ensure you that we're working on [b]adding free movement[/b] in full swing and this update should be ready in a few weeks. You can let us know what things should we fix in the next patch. Future content updates will come after implementation of free movement.

[update] We've pushed another small patch with bugfixes. Details below.


[h1]Patch 1.01 Changelog:[/h1]

[b]GENERAL CHANGES[/b]
[list]
[*]Added note informing about early access upon startup
[*]Added scoreboard next to the level summary after each stage
[*]Teleporters next to the crystal encounter are now easier to notice on stage Ruins 0
[*]Added missing Motion Controller vibrations to world interactions
[*]Changed interactive torches’ burn time from 4 to 10 seconds
[/list]

[b]SPELLS[/b]
[list]
[*]Added missing Motion Controller vibrations to some spells

[*]Pyroblast:
- Slightly reduced the maximal size
- Moved the orb slightly from the head in order not to clip into the player’s camera

[*]Frost Bow:
- Added visual effects indicating how many arrows can be shot
- Increased the size of the quiver area behind player’s head
- Added the ability to grab arrows using Trigger on the Motion Controller
- Slightly increased gesture error tolerance while casting
- Improved Frost Bow’s behaviour when firing arrows in a rapid succession

[*] Arcane Missiles: Slightly increased gesture error tolerance while casting
[/list]

[h1]Patch 1.02 Changelog:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed the bug making Pause Menu in HUB non-interactive
[*]Early Access disclaimer is now translated to German and Chinese
[*]All spells got a little bigger error tolerance while casting
[*]Fireball and Pyroblast should now be easier to cast
[*]Opening Pause Menu while holding bow will no longer duplicate arrow counter.
[/list]

You're welcome to join our [url=https://discord.gg/xctRHJn]Discord server[/url] and share your feedback!

[update] We've pushed another small patch with bugfixes. Details below.


[h1]Patch 1.01 Changelog:[/h1]

[b]GENERAL CHANGES[/b]
[list]
[*]Added note informing about early access upon startup
[*]Added scoreboard next to the level summary after each stage
[*]Teleporters next to the crystal encounter are now easier to notice on stage Ruins 0
[*]Added missing Motion Controller vibrations to world interactions
[*]Changed interactive torches’ burn time from 4 to 10 seconds
[/list]

[b]SPELLS[/b]
[list]
[*]Added missing Motion Controller vibrations to some spells

[*]Pyroblast:
- Slightly reduced the maximal size
- Moved the orb slightly from the head in order not to clip into the player’s camera

[*]Frost Bow:
- Added visual effects indicating how many arrows can be shot
- Increased the size of the quiver area behind player’s head
- Added the ability to grab arrows using Trigger on the Motion Controller
- Slightly increased gesture error tolerance while casting
- Improved Frost Bow’s behaviour when firing arrows in a rapid succession

[*] Arcane Missiles: Slightly increased gesture error tolerance while casting
[/list]

[h1]Patch 1.02 Changelog:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed the bug making Pause Menu in HUB non-interactive
[*]Early Access disclaimer is now translated to German and Chinese
[*]All spells got a little bigger error tolerance while casting
[*]Fireball and Pyroblast should now be easier to cast
[*]Opening Pause Menu while holding bow will no longer duplicate arrow counter.
[/list]
